The barcode application (barcode.html) reads QR codes and other barcodes with the camera or from pictures, and creates them – for links, Wi-Fi access, contacts, e-mails and any text. Everything runs in the browser; images and contents are not sent anywhere.

Supported codes: QR Code, Micro QR Code, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417 (2D) and Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF and Codabar (1D bar codes). Reading also recognises further formats (for example DataBar, MaxiCode, rMQR).

Reading

  • 📷 Camera starts the camera (the browser asks for permission); codes in the picture are marked green and listed as soon as they are recognised. 🔄 Switch camera changes between the cameras of the device; ⏹ Stop camera ends it.
  • 🖼 Open image… (Ctrl+O) reads codes from image files (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, AVIF). You can also drop images onto the window or paste one from the clipboard (Ctrl+V), e.g. a screenshot. Several codes in one image are found together.
  • Every code appears once in the list with its format and its content type: link, Wi-Fi, contact (vCard/MeCard), e-mail, phone number, SMS, location, one-time password setup (otpauth://), calendar event or text. The details (e.g. network name and password) are shown below the text.
  • Actions: Copy the text, Open link (only http/https, in a new tab), copy the Wi-Fi password, Save contact (.vcf), Save event (.ics), and Edit in the generator, which takes the content to the Create tab.

Check links before you open them – a QR code can lead anywhere. The application never opens links by itself.

Creating

  1. Choose the content: Text, Link, Wi-Fi, Contact, E-mail, Phone number, SMS or Location, and fill in the fields. The text of the code is built from them (e.g. WIFI:T:WPA;S:Home;P:secret;; or a vCard); open Content below the preview to see it.
  2. Choose the format. For QR codes the error correction sets how much of the code may be damaged or covered (L 7 %, M 15 %, Q 25 %, H 30 %). 1D codes accept only certain characters (EAN/UPC: digits with the check digit calculated) – an example is filled in when you switch to one; an error message explains invalid contents.
  3. Set the module size (pixels per square or bar), the quiet zone (white margin in modules; scanners need it), for 1D codes the bar height and the text below the bars, and the colours or a transparent background. Keep dark codes on a light background with enough contrast.

The preview is read back automatically: ✓ readable confirms that the code can be scanned. ⬇ SVG (scalable, for print) and ⬇ PNG download the code, Copy image puts it on the clipboard, 🖨 Print prints only the code.

Keyboard shortcuts

On a Mac, use Cmd instead of Ctrl. F1 (or ?) shows this list in the application.

Files

Keys Function
Ctrl+O Open images and read their codes
Ctrl+V Read the code of a pasted image

Help

Keys Function
F1 / ? show this list (outside of text fields)

On phones and tablets

The camera of the back is used first; Switch camera changes to the front camera. The generator shows the code above the form. Downloaded images go to the download folder of the browser.
